messages.notice.body:
The predicted configurations are for reference. Please review them against the structure.

In previous tests, direct His recommendations agreed with reference labels about 60% of the time. Sites predicted to remain deprotonated or unflipped agreed with manual labels about 99% of the time.

PROPKA estimates pKa. A dash (—) means the program has no assignment or pKa estimate.

messages.settings.help:
Leave Target Chains blank to inspect all chains. Leave pH blank if unknown.
Search radius must cover the H-bond limits and the {metal_radius:g} Å metal search range.
The carboxylate cutoff is also capped by the search radius. Leave PyMOL path blank to auto-detect.
